notes.key_messages:
The Question Paper requires answers to be written in dark blue or black ink; the use of pencils by candidates
in writing formulae, structures and equations is to be strongly discouraged. Pencilled text is sometimes too
faint to read. The practice of over-writing pencil in ink should be discouraged as answers often become
illegible.
notes.general_comments:
This paper gave candidates of all abilities the opportunity to demonstrate their knowledge and understanding
of a wide range of chemistry topics.
There was no evidence of candidates being short of time.
Candidates need to show clear working in mathematical questions; where a final answer is incorrect, credit
can often be obtained from correct working.
This report should be read in conjunction with the published mark scheme for this paper, which offers
accepted answers to the questions.
